name: La Meute
summary: La Meute is an online party game where players compete in a tournament of short minigames. Players answer quiz questions, draw, test their memory and race to react. Each round contributes to the final score. Players can play solo, face one opponent in a duel, compete in a free-for-all with 3 to 12 players, or form teams with up to 16 players in total.
